fields.label: SharePoint tenant host
fields.help: Exact SharePoint tenant host, such as tenant.sharepoint.com, without a scheme or path.

fields.label: Microsoft Entra tenant ID
fields.help: Tenant identifier used by delegated MSAL and app-only authentication.

fields.label: Microsoft Entra client ID
fields.help: Public or confidential application client identifier.

fields.label: Microsoft Entra client secret
fields.help: Write-only secret used only by app-only authentication.

fields.label: Microsoft Graph scopes
fields.help: Space- or comma-separated delegated scopes, or one .default scope for app-only/Azure CLI.

fields.label: Delegated account
fields.help: Optional account ID or username when the delegated cache contains multiple accounts.

fields.label: Authorized download root
fields.help: Profile-relative or absolute directory authorized for SharePoint downloads.

fields.label: Authorized upload root
fields.help: Profile-relative or absolute directory from which SharePoint uploads may read.

fields.label: Enrolled browser profile
fields.help: Name of a Hermes-owned enrolled browser profile trusted for the SharePoint tenant origin.

setup_actions.label: Authenticate Microsoft Graph
setup_actions.help: Open the explicit delegated sign-in flow and persist only the protected profile cache.

setup_actions.label: Test Microsoft Graph connection
setup_actions.help: Use the configured identity silently to verify access to the tenant site.

setup_actions.label: Enroll SharePoint browser
setup_actions.help: Open the named Hermes enrolled browser profile for SharePoint sign-in.

setup_actions.label: Release SharePoint browser session
setup_actions.help: Release only the browser session acquired by this connector.
